beats.say: What if every human on Earth vanished… tonight?
At first, the lights stay on.
But with no one to run them, power plants start shutting down.
Pets and zoo animals roam the empty streets.
Within a few years, plants crack through every road.
In a few decades, skyscrapers start to fall.
After thousands of years, what's left of us?
Things carved in stone, like the pyramids.
Earth heals… and forgets we were ever here.
Would the planet even miss us?
